catalog_quirks.body: Selected LLMTR routes are zero-priced with daily or rolling request quotas, not monthly cash credits. Motif 3 replenishes each allowance after 24 hours. New accounts have reduced free allowances until 24 hours old; no top-up is required to wait for that increase. Exact account caps are not assumed. Text completions passed on 2026-09-29; tool and vision flags remain off until separately tested. The public roster also includes paid, temporary and BYOK-only models which are not included here. See https://llmtr.com/docs/en/migration/openai-openrouter/ and https://llmtr.com/docs/en/gateway/motif-3/.
